components.name: ActivityIndicator
components.purpose: Activity indicator is used to present progress of some activity in the app.
components.notes: progress or waiting indicator

components.name: Appbar
components.purpose: A component to display action items in a bar.
components.notes: app chrome: carries actions, shows no data shape

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Avatars can be used to represent people in a graphical way.
components.notes: documented through Avatar.Text; Avatar.Icon and Avatar.Image are in the sidebar

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Badges are small status descriptors for UI elements.
components.notes: a flag or count next to something

components.name: Banner
components.purpose: Banner displays a prominent message and related actions.

components.name: BottomNavigation
components.purpose: BottomNavigation provides quick navigation between top-level views of an app with a bottom navigation bar.
components.notes: navigation chrome, no data shape

components.name: Button
components.purpose: A button is component that the user can press to trigger an action.
components.notes: an action, not a data shape

components.name: Card
components.purpose: A card is a sheet of material that serves as an entry point to more detailed information.
components.notes: a container: what it shows depends on its content

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Checkboxes allow the selection of multiple options from a set.
components.notes: multi selection

components.name: Chip
components.purpose: Chips are compact elements that can represent inputs, attributes, or actions.

components.name: DataTable
components.purpose: Data tables allow displaying sets of data.
components.notes: the comparable-columns case of collection (columns 2 or more); pagination part exists

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: Dialogs inform users about a specific task and may contain critical information, require decisions, or involve multiple tasks
components.notes: the page sentence is quoted without its final period

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: A divider is a thin, lightweight separator that groups content in lists and page layouts.
components.notes: separator, no data shape

components.name: Drawer.Item
components.purpose: A component used to show an action item with an icon and a label in a navigation drawer.
components.notes: navigation chrome

components.name: FAB
components.purpose: A floating action button represents the primary action on a screen.
components.notes: an action

components.name: HelperText
components.purpose: Helper text is used in conjuction with input elements to provide additional hints for the user.
components.notes: a hint tied to an input

components.name: IconButton
components.purpose: An icon button is a button which displays only an icon without a label.
components.notes: an action

components.name: List.Item
components.purpose: A component to show tiles inside a List.
components.notes: rows of items; also settings rows

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: Menus display a list of choices on temporary elevated surfaces.

components.name: Modal
components.purpose: The Modal component is a simple way to present content above an enclosing view.
components.notes: container, no data shape

components.name: ProgressBar
components.purpose: Progress bar is an indicator used to present progress of some activity in the app.
components.notes: progress kind of value

components.name: RadioButton
components.purpose: Radio buttons allow the selection a single option from a set.
components.notes: single selection

components.name: Searchbar
components.purpose: Searchbar is a simple input box where users can type search queries.
components.notes: no suggestions list is described on the page

components.name: SegmentedButtons
components.purpose: Segmented buttons can be used to select options, switch views or sort elements.

components.name: Snackbar
components.purpose: Snackbars provide brief feedback about an operation through a message rendered at the bottom of the container
components.notes: the page sentence is quoted without its final period

components.name: Surface
components.purpose: Surface is a basic container that can give depth to an element with elevation shadow.
components.notes: container, no data shape

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: Switch is a visual toggle between two mutually exclusive states — on and off.
components.notes: toggle input

components.name: TextInput
components.purpose: A component to allow users to input text.

components.name: ToggleButton
components.purpose: Toggle buttons can be used to group related options.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Tooltips display informative text when users hover over, focus on, or tap an element.
components.notes: hover is not a phone interaction (V-37): no data shape
